Value DeFi’s MultiStablesVault on Ethereum was exploited for approximately $6 million through a flash loan and oracle manipulation. The attacker used a flash loan to distort Curve stablecoin prices, allowing them to mint and redeem vault shares at artificially favorable rates in a single transaction. The vault’s price oracle trusted unreliable spot prices vulnerable to manipulation. The vault minted shares based on conversion rates from Curve pool spot prices.
